data: NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 ended on January 28, 2024. For that year it reported record revenue of about $60.9 billion ($60,922 million), up 126% from $27.0 billion ($26,974 million) in fiscal 2023. GAAP net income was about $29.8 billion ($29,760 million), up roughly 581% from $4.4 billion in fiscal 2023. Diluted earnings per share were $11.93 on a pre-split basis. The growth came mainly from the Data Center segment, whose revenue rose 217% to a record $47.5 billion on demand for its Hopper-architecture GPUs used in AI training and inference.
